title: on a midsummer night… I experience an actual midsummer’s night dream ...
transcript: on a midsummer's night I am having a dream of a theater trip every time I come to London I feel like it is my personal obligation to go and see some Shakespeare I try to see something I haven't seen before or something totally unique while I have seen a midsummer night’s dream before in fact I might even say it's my favorite shakespeare play I've never seen anything like the immersive midsummer night's dream at the bridge theatre this production is happening all around you it is joyful and wild queer and romantic while they do have seats I did standing so I was right in the middle of the action with fairies flying over my head and the forest blooming all around me I don't wanna spoil too much because there are so many fun surprises but one of my favorite things they do is switch titania and oberon so she's the one pulling the prank so poor lovestruck oberon falls in love with the a** I was in tears it's so funny especially during a very particular bubble bath scene I won't spoil and don't even get me started on this interval aerial ballet I was enthralled the cast was exceptional especially david morrit the most charming mischievous puck in the world with wild acrobatic skills this might be the most joyful innovative shakespeare production I've ever seen complete with multiple dance parties because of course and giant moon size beach balls that were actually quite heavy if you've never been a shakespeare person this is the one that will change your mind and if you already love him like me you're in for something unforgettable a midsummer night’s dream is playing until august 20th at the bridge theatre this is the party of the summer
classificationReason: Creator is reviewing an immersive Midsummer Night's Dream at the Bridge Theatre in London, but this production is not included in the provided list of shows to classify
